scope: First two preselected development questions, full corpus, single-agent integration. Not a comparative effectiveness or benchmark score claim.
terminal_policy: First nonempty assistant response without tools and with stop finish reason; no partial length output, no post-hoc best answer selection.
retrieval_policy: Whole fixed BM25 corpus; search max10 and initial2048 Unicode characters, get_document max8000 per page with offsets. No hidden truncation of full history.
selection_policy: Precommitted12 IDs; use first2 in original order without outcome-based replacement.
setup_accounting: Persistent retriever per trial. Record startup separately from1800-second model/tool episode; batch records complete subprocess wall time.
judge_policy: Independent after terminal artifact validation. Official pinned Qwen3-32B template/parser; candidate MLX BF16 backend in separate process; no correctness until judged.
